entries.title: Bilingual Hindi-English Storytime / द्विभाषी हिंदी-अंग्रेज़ी कहानी समय
entries.description: This special Storytime helps children strengthen their language comprehension skills while enjoying traditional rhymes and stories from the Indian culture. \nOffered monthly, this engaging program is aimed for kids ages 3-10 and their families, but all ages and language abilities are welcome to join!

entries.title: Thanksgiving Storytime and Craft Extravaganza
entries.description: Enjoy heartwarming stories and sing-along songs that celebrate family, thankfulness, and togetherness.\nAfter storytime, join us for a variety of fun art and craft activities, along with tasty snacks to get everyone into the holiday spirit!

entries.title: Family Storytime
entries.description: Family Storytime is designed to accommodate a mix of ages and invites the entire family to participate in early literacy activities such as stories, songs, rhymes, fingerplays, and movement.

entries.title: Musical Instrument Petting Zoo
entries.description: Make music together in this drop-in program for young children and caregivers.

entries.title: Reading to Children
entries.description: Children will have fun listening to stories while they develop a love for books and reading.

entries.title: Bilingual French Storytime
entries.description: Bilingual French Storytime is designed to accommodate a mix of ages and invites the entire family to participate in early literacy activities such as stories, songs, rhymes, fingerplays, and movement activities.

entries.title: Code on Swift Playground
entries.description: Learn how to code using Swift Playgrounds.

entries.title: Family Movie Club: Wonder
entries.description: Popcorn will be provided, and we will have coloring pages available for those who prefer a quiet activity during the movie.\nFree.

entries.title: TeenHQ MakerSpace Studio
entries.description: Up to 5 teens at a time can use the space to utilize our 3D printers, Poster Printer, GlowForge, Sewing Serger Machines, Cricut, Button Press, and miscellaneous craft supplies.

entries.title: Wacky Wednesdays: Coffee Filter Turkey craft
entries.description: Each week we focus on a different themed artwork or craft.

entries.title: Glider Discovery
entries.description: Discover the world of flight in a special outdoor family event!

entries.title: Plan Your 2027 Garden with My California Garden
entries.description: Gardening enthusiasts of every generation are welcome to join us as we dream big and design together.

entries.title: Magical Santa Dance Party with SF Autism Society
entries.description: Dance the evening away with our inclusive DJs, Lori and RJ, snap a photo with Santa, make festive holiday crafts, and show off your most creative outfit in our Ugly Sweater Contest!

entries.title: Open Mic
entries.description: Bring your guitar, ukulele, voice, or any fun instruments you have been practicing to perform in an open mic setting.

entries.title: Straw Rocket Workshop
entries.description: Use a variety of common craft materials to convert a bottle into a high performance rocket vehicle.

entries.title: Popsicle Stick Christmas Tree Craft Ornament
entries.description: Come Join us this holiday season and create a Christmas Tree with Popsicle Sticks!

entries.title: Members Only: Wings & Winter Wishes
entries.description: Cozy up with a warm cup of hot chocolate and settle in at our holiday card making station.

entries.title: Friends of the Campbell Library Used Book Sale
entries.description: Items for sale include puzzles, games, hardback fiction books, children's books, romances, thrillers, audio books, DVDs, CDs, and a variety of 'how to' books.
entries.priorTitleZh: Campbell 图书馆之友二手书义卖
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 出售拼图、游戏、精装小说、儿童读物、爱情小说、惊悚小说、有声读物、DVD、CD 和各类实用指南书。接受现金、支票、Zelle、银行卡或 Venmo 付款。请自带购物袋！

entries.title: Music & Movement Special Guest-Marylee Sunseri
entries.description: Children and their families are invited to dance sing and learn together!

entries.title: Mend with Friends
entries.description: Limited mending supplies for hand sewing and casual instruction are available, but bringing your own favorite tools, extra buttons, fabric scraps, or experience to share is always appreciated.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 如果对缝纫感兴趣，初学者也可以学习基本手缝针法。不必预先登记；请带上需要修补的物品、正在制作的作品，或使用现场布料边角料练习基本针法。

entries.title: Miss Molly Bubbles

entries.priorDescriptionZh: 这场适合各年龄段的表演将带来惊奇与欢笑。由于场地有限，活动开始前 30 分钟将发放免费入场券。

entries.title: Tiny Toots Concert: Farmer Arann
entries.description: Farmer Arann will be here with his instruments, big voice, unique songs, and super fun personality!
entries.priorDescriptionZh: Farmer Arann 将带着乐器、洪亮的歌声、独特的歌曲和活泼有趣的风格来到现场！

entries.title: Adult & Teen Crafternoon: Felted Snowmen
entries.description: Come learn the basics of needle felting to create a cozy winter friend, from a simple snowman for beginner's to a more elaborate snow animal if you'd like to experiment!

entries.priorDescriptionZh: 如有示范，将在下午 3 点活动开始时进行；其他时间也会提供说明，并有工作人员解答问题。十二月的手工主题是羊毛毡雪人！

entries.title: Open Poetry Readings
entries.description: Everyone is welcome to attend and listen or read poetry and join in related discussions.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 欢迎任何人参加聆听、朗读诗歌并参与相关讨论。每月第二个星期六举行，无需报名。Garlicky Group of Poets 自 1995 年起在 Gilroy 图书馆举办活动，每月吸引南县各地居民参与。

entries.title: Merry Pixie Pages
